success: All admitted finite diagnostic outputs and controls are collected with complete source/input/command/resource custody. Ordinary and null observations are legitimate outcomes. Control failures invalidate the affected measurement rather than supporting a hypothesis.
failure: Exact encoding/rewrite/receipt/certificate counterexamples reject only the frozen construction at its declared scope; all cases retained
